```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** U31_10_Lab_Management_System

**Test Suite Description:** This test suite covers the functionalities of the Lab Management System (LMS) for lab in-charge, patient, and admin users.

**Test Suite Scope:**
- Viewing open lab requests
- Updating lab request status
- Submitting lab reports
- Viewing prescriptions
- Printing invoices
- Archiving patient profiles and consultation requests

**Test Suite Preconditions:**
- The LMS is running and accessible.
- User accounts are created for lab in-charge, patient, and admin.

**Test Suite Postconditions:**
- All test cases should complete successfully without errors.

**Test Case Table:**

| Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-001 | View Open Lab Requests | Req-10 | Positive | Lab in-charge logged in | None | Navigate to lab request page, filter for open requests | Display list of open lab requests |
| TC-002 | Update Lab Request Status | Req-10 | Positive | Lab in-charge logged in, selected lab request | Status update options | Select status "Actual Sample Collection", click update button | Lab request status updated to "Actual Sample Collection" |
| TC-003 | Offline Sample Collection and Lab Tests | Req-10 | Positive | Lab in-charge logged in, selected lab request | None | Check if sample collection and lab tests options are available offline | Offline mode available for sample collection and lab tests |
| TC-004 | Submit Offline Lab Report | Req-10 | Positive | Lab in-charge logged in, selected lab request | Offline report file | Click submit report button | Report submitted successfully with "Collected" status |
| TC-005 | View Prescription | Req-11 | Positive | Patient logged in | None | Navigate to prescription page | Display patient's prescription |
| TC-006 | Print Invoice | Req-11 | Positive | Patient logged in | None | Click print invoice button | Invoice printed successfully |
| TC-007 | Admin Print and Email Prescription and Invoice | Req-11 | Positive | Admin logged in, selected patient | None | Click print and email invoice button | Prescription and invoice printed and emailed to patient |
| TC-008 | View Archived Patient Profiles | Req-12 | Positive | Admin logged in | Date range | Filter for patients with no consultation requests for 3 years | Display list of archived patient profiles |
| TC-009 | View Archived Consultation Requests | Req-12 | Positive | Admin logged in | Date range | Filter for consultation requests older than 3 years | Display list of archived consultation requests |
| TC-010 | Negative Viewing Lab Requests | Req-10 | Negative | Unauthorized user attempts to access lab request page | None | Attempt to access lab request page | Access denied message displayed |
| TC-011 | Negative Updating Lab Request Status | Req-10 | Negative | Lab in-charge attempts to update status of non-existent request | Invalid request ID | Attempt to update non-existent request status | Error message displayed |
| TC-012 | Boundary 3-Year Threshold | Req-12 | Boundary | Admin sets date range to exactly 3 years | 3 years | Filter for patients with no consultation requests within 3 years | Display list of archived patient profiles |
| TC-013 | Boundary 3-Year Threshold | Req-12 | Boundary | Admin sets date range to 3 years minus 1 day | 3 years minus 1 day | Filter for patients with no consultation requests within 3 years minus 1 day | Display list of archived patient profiles |

```
